items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Freddie Waits, Bob Cranshaw, Richard Landrum, Warren Smith.

ctx.x: My first recording as a leader was for Muse, Muse Records, which was run at the time by two guys. There was a partnership, Don Schlitten and Joe Fields. It was Don Schlitten who contacted me. It was called Sunset to Dawn with – who is it? Freddie Waits.
Freddie Waits, Bob Cranshaw, Richard Landrum, Warren Smith.
Yeah. For me it was – wow, it was great.
